worldcombat.skill.thundercage.summary: A freely aimed jolt raises a ring of vertical current bars with a top rim around the target, sealing it in a cage of finite height: move freely inside, and only the moment you cross the side wall gets one arc and a throw-back, while the cage keeps striking it and may paralyze it. Leaping over the top or powering through the side wall with native knockback resistance escapes outright - a breakthrough, never a remote infinite pull. The wide style is broader and lasts longer; the tight style is smaller and shocks harder.
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.use.0: Lock a highly mobile target into a small patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.use.1: Pressure a foe with repeated shocks and paralysis
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.use.2: Throw a charging target back into the fight
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.use.3: Lock down a key target in a narrow place
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.descriptio: The jolt deals about %1$s special damage and raises a ring of current bars around the target.

The cage lasts %1$s, striking every %2$s for about %3$s special damage; each strike has a %4$s chance to paralyze the target, which halves its movement speed and gives its actions a 25%% chance to fail, lasting about 40 s.

Cage radius %1$s blocks, height %2$s blocks: moving inside never touches the bars, and only the moment of crossing the side wall throws the target back with one shock; going over the top or powering through with native knockback resistance escapes outright. Range %3$s blocks, bolt speed %4$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.option.on: Wide style on: cage radius x1.35, duration x1.15, cooldown +8, but initial hit x0.9 and shocks x0.85 - a wider, longer cage.
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.option.off: Wide style off (tight): a smaller, tighter cage with a shorter cooldown, full initial hit and shocks - it shocks harder.
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.timing: Castable on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; recover %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.growth.0: At level %1$s the initial hit rises to %2$s and the cage radius to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.thundercage.preference: On: cage radius x1.35, duration x1.15, cooldown +8, but initial hit x0.9 and shocks x0.85 - a wider, longer cage. Off: smaller and tighter, shocks harder.
Only consider raising a cage on a threat within this distance; lower it to cage only up close, raise it to enclose from farther away.

On: only cage a moving or fleeing threat, limiting a strafer's edges; off: willing to cage any threat in range. Against a natively push-resistant target it counts only the initial hit and periodic shocks, never an infinite lock.
